title: 2.5.2 Video — Memory: What Stays, What Disappears
description: A game resets to zero on refresh. Variables live in RAM — gone when the tab closes. Saved data lives on disk — still there tomorrow. This short video contrasts both so you understand what persistence actually means.
videoFallback: Teacher-recorded walkthrough. Ask your teacher for the YouTube link, or open the classroom slide deck for the live demo.
